from markdownify import MarkdownConverter

conv = MarkdownConverter()
values = [
    conv.convert_code(None, 'tick ` one', set()),
    conv.convert_code(None, 'pair `` two', set()),
    conv.convert_code(None, ' plain ', set()),
]

print(values)
print([value.count('`') for value in values])
print(values[1])
